paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得改期时问过一次关系是否改变，另一次则在没有新变化时又确认之前的回答。问题发生的背景与再次提问的动作可以分别描述，不需要复述对方回答，也不能由重复次数断定回答真假。例子不要求再联系、索取承诺或证明自己能够不问。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls asking whether a rescheduled plan meant a changed connection, then checking an earlier answer again on another occasion without a new change. Context and the repeated request can be described separately without repeating anyone’s reply or using recurrence to establish its truth. The scene requires no new contact, requested promise or proof of being able not to ask.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想理解虚构情境里重复回到的是哪个问题，不请你替任何人保证感情。”可以只读这一卡。听者可区分新增信息与原问题再次出现，不把请求贴成人格标签，也不把明确表达当成对方必须继续回答的义务；双方都可停止。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks which question recurs in the fictional scene without asking a listener to guarantee anyone’s feelings. Read only the card if preferred. A listener can distinguish new information from a returning question, assign no personality label and treat clear expression as no obligation for someone else to keep answering. Either participant can stop.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是依恋量表解释、心理健康评估或对特定关系的建议。16条仍围绕心中选定的一位亲近成年人，按过去三个月自报频率直接评分；1从不、2很少、3有时、4经常、5几乎每次，3不代表不确定。每项四条至少三条数字才显示独立一位小数均值，例如2、3、5加一条未评分得3.3，两条则资料不足；不补零、补3或借其他项作答。频率均值不说明发生次数、想法持续时间、强烈程度、原因或他人的意图。四项可同时高、低或相同，不合总分、选主导、分沉重等级或识别人身标签；较低不证明平静、信任或健康沟通。原题本尚无已建立的信效度、常模或中英文测量等值。无需提供姓名、聊天记录、披露答案、联系、监控、试探、要求承诺或改变关系。所有组合仍开放四篇全文；原有可选标签页草稿24小时期限及完成、重测清除保持不变，复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含个人答案或均值。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not attachment-scale interpretations, mental health assessment or advice about a particular relationship. Sixteen prompts retain one adult close person held in mind and direct self-reported frequency over the past three months: 1 never, 2 rarely, 3 sometimes, 4 often and 5 almost always. Three does not mean uncertainty. Each part needs at least three numeric ratings out of four for an independent one-decimal mean. For example, 2, 3 and 5 with one unscored response give 3.3; two ratings are insufficient, without imputed zero or three or answers borrowed from other parts. Frequency means establish no event count, thought duration, intensity, cause or other person’s intention. All four parts can be high, low or equal without a total, dominant type, heaviness level or personal label. Lower means establish neither calmness, trust nor healthy communication. The original form lacks established reliability, validity, norms or English–Chinese measurement equivalence. No names, message history, answer disclosure, contact, monitoring, checks, promises or changed relationship are required. Every pattern retains all four full guides. Existing optional tab drafts retain their 24-hour expiry and completion or retake clearing. Copying includes only the public title and entry link, without personal answers or means.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一次随口提及后来反复回到脑中，却很少比较自己与别人的位置。注意持续回返与位置比较不是同一条回答，更不能合成关于第三人的事实。例子只描述自己的注意，不要求回看聊天、搜索线索、找人作证或请别人排除怀疑。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls returning to a passing mention but rarely comparing their place with someone else’s. Returning attention and comparison are different answers, neither combining into a fact about a third person. The scene describes the reader’s attention without a message-history review, search for clues, witness or request that someone disprove a suspicion.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我们能否只比较情境中注意到的内容和随后想到的解释，不猜任何人的意图？”无需姓名或真实经历。听者不把更常想起某事当作直觉更准，也不把较少想起当作信任证明；不讨论第三人或不继续均可。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card compares what was noticed in a scene with the interpretation that followed, without guessing intentions. No names or personal experience are needed. A listener treats more frequent thoughts as no sharper intuition and fewer thoughts as no proof of trust. Leave third parties out or end the discussion if preferred.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一次额外帮忙时确实期待联结更稳，也记得另一次帮忙只是方便。题目中明说的期待适用于前者，不自动套到所有付出上；同一件事也可能有多个目的。期待与实际回应分别保留，不从均值推断付出超过余量、动机不真诚或别人欠回报。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls offering extra help with an actual hope for a steadier connection, while another favour was simply convenient. The prompt’s stated hope applies to the former without being assigned to every contribution. Several purposes may coexist. Hope and actual response remain separate without a mean establishing exceeded capacity, insincerity or a debt of reciprocation.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只谈虚构人物提供了什么、期待了什么，不替另一人规定回应。”可以不提供自己的例子。听者不把帮助折算成关心份额，也不要求多做、撤回或用付出来验证关系；可与独立的可用余量问题分开，到此结束也完整。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card discusses what a fictional person offered and hoped for without prescribing the other person’s response. No personal example is needed. A listener converts no help into a share of care and requires neither additional giving, withdrawal nor a contribution used to test a relationship. Keep available-capacity questions separate or finish here.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一次少联系只是想休息，另一次留下暗示却是为了看别人会不会追问。两种目的不相同，外表相似的暂停不能替自己回答题中意图。报告也不知道对方是否看见暗示，不以回应或沉默认证在意程度，更不建议重做一次来验证。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls less contact simply for rest, and a different hint intended to see whether someone would ask more. These purposes differ. An outwardly similar pause cannot supply the stated intention for the reader. The report does not know whether a hint was noticed, certifies no amount of care from a reply or silence and recommends no repeated check.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“在虚构情境中，可以分开写人物做了什么、原本想知道什么，别替收到暗示的人猜答案。”无需发送任何消息。听者不把需要休息等同试探，不教授更有效的暗示或逼问回应；可略过所有私人部分，只读公开指南。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a fictional person’s action from what they wanted to know, without guessing an answer for the recipient of a hint. No message needs to be sent. A listener equates no need for rest with a check and teaches no more effective hint or demanded response. Leave out all private details and read only the public guide if preferred.
